context: Checks the review applies SOLID where there is design pain, prefers composition to deep inheritance, and repairs the LSP contract with a Result type.

checklist.name: Rejects mechanical application
checklist.description: The review says SOLID is a set of guidelines and should not be applied to every class regardless of context.

checklist.name: Flags one-implementation interfaces
checklist.description: The 22 single-implementation interfaces are identified as indirection with no benefit.

checklist.name: Applies SOLID only where pain exists
checklist.description: The review names concrete pain signals (tight coupling, change in one direction, hard to test) as the criterion for keeping an abstraction.

checklist.name: Rejects the four-level hierarchy
checklist.description: The `PremiumUser` chain is identified as fragile deep inheritance.

checklist.name: Proposes composition
checklist.description: The review proposes injecting behaviour, for example a feature-set object passed to `User`.

checklist.name: Explains open for extension, closed for modification
checklist.description: The composition proposal explains how new perks can be added without editing `User`.

checklist.name: Identifies the LSP violation
checklist.description: `CachedRepository.save()` is named as breaking the base contract.

checklist.name: Explains the impact on callers
checklist.description: The review says callers that do not catch exceptions will fail when the cache is full.

checklist.name: Proposes a Result type
checklist.description: The fix returns a Result type rather than throwing, keeping the base contract.

checklist.name: Keeps abstractions that earn their place
checklist.description: The review does not recommend removing every interface; it keeps those with real pain or multiple implementations.
